item.description:
Fixes and Improvements

  • Fixes an issue where the preselected location for new areas and the preselected location and area for new points of interest did not respect the current selection
  • Before creating a new point of interest, a category has to be explicitly selected now
  • Improves the preselection of location/area pairs when assigning points of interest to multiple locations and areas
  • When no item is being edited in the inspector, clicking an icon in the Icons window now copies the icon’s name instead of doing nothing

New Features

  • Adds and updates icons

Fixes and Improvements

  • Fixes an issue where the window’s minimum width was extremely large on macOS Tahoe 26 and later
  • Fixes an issue where the points of interest list was not displayed correctly
  • When selecting an item using the keyboard navigation, the selection is now scrolled into view
  • Fixes a minor visual appearance issue in the icon category view

New Features

  • Updates the visual appearance throughout the app
  • The database content can now be navigated using the arrow keys on the keyboard
  • Adds a new Icons window for picking icons more conveniently
  • dds new icons and updates existing ones

Fixes and Improvements

  • New items will be selected after being created
  • The title text field is now focused when creating a new item
  • Fixes an issue where the sidebar’s scroll position was incorrect after launching the app
  • Improves the icon category views
  • Improves the content filter bars
  • Fixes layout issues in the Updates settings view

New Features

  • Adds “hidden areas” that show contained points of interest on an elevated level
  • Adds a badge displaying the number of points of interest in each category
  • Adds a filter bar for switching between areas and categories
  • Adds app update settings (MAPO → Settings…)
  • Adds a Statistics window (Window → Statistics)

Fixes and Improvements

  • Improves the app’s visual appearance
  • Area groups are now only displayed as selectable section headers
  • Unifies the action buttons across all inspectors

Known Issues

  • After creating an item, it is not automatically selected
  • When creating a new item, the Title Prefix text field is focused instead of the Title text field
  • When creating a new item from the File → New menu, the currently selected items are not used as defaults for the new item. Use the Create Item menu in the toolbar instead
  • The keyboard shortcut for creating a new point of interest is currently only assigned to the toolbar command until using the menu bar command uses the correct defaults for new items. To make the app recognize the keyboard shortcut, the toolbar menu needs to be opened once after launch

New Features

  • Adds icon categories

Fixes and Improvements

  • Improves the visual appearance of the icon picker
  • Displays the prefixes and suffixes of resorts in the sidebar

Known Issues

  • The Save Changes and Revert Changes buttons flash briefly after selecting a point of interest
  • After creating an item, it is not automatically selected
  • When creating a new item, the Title Prefix text field is focused instead of the Title text field
  • When creating a new item from the File → New menu, the currently selected items are not used as defaults for the new item. Use the Create Item menu in the toolbar instead
  • The keyboard shortcut for creating a new point of interest is currently only assigned to the toolbar command until using the menu bar command uses the correct defaults for new items. To make the app recognize the keyboard shortcut, the toolbar menu needs to be opened once after launch
  • The New Location window is initially narrower than intended

New Features

  • Adds new icons and updates existing ones
  • Updates the app icon

Fixes and Improvements

  • Adjusts the padding of icon container views
  • Updates default icons

Known Issues

  • The Save Changes and Revert Changes buttons flash briefly after selecting a point of interest
  • After creating an item, it is not automatically selected
  • When creating a new item, the Title Prefix text field is focused instead of the Title text field
  • When creating a new item from the File → New menu, the currently selected items are not used as defaults for the new item. Use the Create Item menu in the toolbar instead
  • The keyboard shortcut for creating a new point of interest is currently only assigned to the toolbar command until using the menu bar command uses the correct defaults for new items. To make the app recognize the keyboard shortcut, the toolbar menu needs to be opened once after launch
  • The New Location window is initially narrower than intended
